## How I checked it
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] I ran the app myself and tried the part I changed (hands in lap where it matters)
- [ ] Every API or package I used really exists (checked the docs / pinned the version)
- [ ] No secrets (API keys, passwords) in the code
- [ ] If AI helped: noted in `AI_USE_LOG.md` (what it wrote, how I checked it)

See `docs/verification.md` for the full checklist.
